bias.en: Bearish · back above $284, closed at the low
bias.zh: 看空 · 重回 $284 上方，收于日内低点

read.en: Alphabet rose 0.8% on Nov 6 to $284.78, trading $284.59–290.49 and closing near the low. It is just above the falling 5-day ($283.1) and below the falling 10-day ($294.1), 30-day ($326.8), 100-day ($341.5) and 200-day ($339.5) averages. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 16, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 16 ($299.60), and RSI is 30.
read.zh: Alphabet 11月6日上涨 0.8%，收于 $284.78，盘中区间 $284.59–290.49，收盘接近日内低点。股价略高于下行的 5 日均线（$283.1），位于下行的 10 日（$294.1）、30 日（$326.8）、100 日（$341.5）和 200 日均线（$339.5）下方。MACD 自 10月16日起位于信号线下方，处于零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月16日起看空（$299.60），RSI 为 30。

read.en: The close reclaimed the $283.4–283.8 area (Nov 4 low, Oct 29 close), now support with the 5-day, but the $290.49 high faded. Resistance is $290.5, then $294.1–296.5 (10-day, Mar 9 low, Nov 4–5 highs) and $299.6–300 (SAR). Support is $283.1–283.8, then $276.9–277.2 and $270.7–272.1. A close above $296.5 would target $300; below $283.1, $277.
